title: High-content imaging and analysis to quantify the nuclear to cytoplasmic ratio of TGFβ and hippo effectors in mammalian cells
protocol: Split sub-confluent EpH4 cells into DMEM supplemented with 10% FBS in 100 mm dishes such that cells reach 50–70% confluency after 24 h.
Trypsinize EpH4 cells for 5 min, neutralize with DMEM containing 10% FBS and count cells using a hemocytometer.
Prepare two 15 ml cell dilution stocks in DMEM containing 10% FBS at 56,000 or 67,200 cells/mL for siCTL or siTaz/Yap, respectively.
Label two 50 mL tubes as siCTL and siTaz/Yap for preparation of transfection solutions.
Mix 196 μL of Opti-MEM with 2 μL of siRNAs for each mL of cell suspension.
Use 1 μL of Taz and 1 μL of Yap siRNA pools for siTaz and siYap respectively.
Use 2 μL of the siRNA pool from a 20 μM stock solution for siCTL.
Mix 2.55 mL of Opti-MEM with 26 μL of siRNAs (13 μL each of siTaz or siYap and 26 μL of siCTL) to prepare 13 mL of cell suspension/transfection solution.
Gently mix by tapping or pipetting.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Add 2 μL of Lipofectamine RNAiMAX per mL of transfection mix (26 μL total).
Mix gently and incubate at room temperature (20°C–25°C) for 20 minutes.
Add 10.4 mL of cell suspension to the corresponding transfection mix.
Pipette up and down gently to thoroughly mix cells and reagents, avoiding bubbles.
Distribute the cell suspension/transfection solution into individual wells using a multichannel pipette.
Seed 0.2 mL of siCTL or siTaz/Yap cell suspension/transfection mix into each of 48 wells in either the 6 left columns or 6 right columns respectively of the 96 well plate for the imaging plate.
Gently shake the plate to distribute cells evenly in wells.
Add 1.25 mL of the siCTL or siTaz/Yap cell suspension/transfection mix per well in duplicate into a 12-well dish.
Place plates in a tissue culture incubator for 20 h.
Add fresh media (0.2 mL per well of DMEM 10% FBS to the 96 well plate and 1.25 mL to wells in the 12 well plates) after 20 h and incubate for 4 h.
Change media with starvation media (media with low serum, 0.1% FBS).
Aspirate old media.
Add 0.2 mL of starvation media to starve cells for varying times as listed in Table 1.
Prepare TGFβ-containing media in PCR tubes by diluting the TGFβ stock solution into starvation media immediately after starvation and before treatment.
Dilute TGFβ into final concentrations of 21, 52.5, 105, 210, 420, and 1050 pM in starvation media.

Using a micro multichannel pipette, add 10 μL of each diluted TGFβ solution to the corresponding wells to achieve final concentrations of 1, 2.5, 5, 10, 20, and 50 pM at indicated times as listed in Table 1.
Follow a similar protocol for transfection, seeding, starvation, and TGFβ treatment of cells for tracking localization of Smad4.
Fix cells.
Stain with antibodies.
Remove media using a multichannel aspirator.
Wash cells 3 times with PBS at room temperature using a multichannel pipette.
Fix cells using 100 μL per well of 4% PFA in PBS at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Wash cells 3 times with PBS-T.
Permeabilize cells using 100 μL per well of 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS for 10 minutes.
Wash cells 3 times with PBS-T.
Block using 100 μL per well of blocking buffer for 1 hour at room temperature.
Incubate with 70–100 μL per well of primary antibodies diluted in blocking buffer at 2°C–8°C overnight, with rocking.
Incubate with 100 μL per well of secondary antibodies (Alexa Fluor® 488 Goat Anti-Rabbit IgG (H+L) and Alexa Fluor® 546 Goat Anti-Mouse IgG (H+L), for Smad2/3 and Taz/Yap, respectively).
Dilute the secondary antibodies at a dilution of 1:1000.
Dilute DAPI at 1 μg/mL in blocking buffer.
Incubate the mixture at RT (20°C–25°C) for 2 h.
Cover the plate with foil to prevent light exposure.
Wash 3 times with PBS-T for 5 min each.
Add 400 μL of cold PBS to each well.
Seal the plate with aluminum foil sealing film.
Select the 20× objective.
Ensure sufficient immersion medium on the objective throughout image acquisition.
Place the 96-well plate into the sample holder.
Position acquisition points in an unbiased way across all the wells in a plate.
Set up 3 acquisition channels to acquire: DAPI, Alexa Fluor® 488, and Alexa Fluor® 546.
Capture 1000 cells per well using 9 fields of view initially.
Focusing must occur prior to each acquisition.
Acquire images along the z-axis with a range of 4–6 μm.
Adjust spacing between adjacent z-slices depending on objective’s NA.
Collapse the 3D datasets into 2D images using maximum intensity projection.
Transfect EpH4 cells with siCTL or siTaz/Yap.
Treat transfected cells with 5 pM TGFβ for 1 h.
Fix the treated cells.
Visualize nuclei using DAPI staining.
Stain Smad proteins with antibodies against Smad2/3.
Stain Smad proteins with antibodies against Smad4.
Calculate the ratio of S_mad_N to S_mad_C for each cell within a well.
For each well, calculate the median value of all the S_mad_N to S_mad_C ratios obtained for each individual cell in a given well.
Calculate the median intensity for the Taz/Yap channel within the nuclear segmentation mask and the cytoplasmic segmentation mask.
Calculate the ratio of Taz/YapN to Taz/YapC for each cell within a well.
For each well, calculate the median value of all the Taz/YapN to Taz/YapC ratios obtained for each individual cell in a given well.
Calculate the median intensity with a cell mask for the Taz/Yap channel (Channel III).
Identify cells with high intensity signals corresponding to wild type cells and those with low intensity signals, which correspond to Yap/Taz depleted cells.
Estimate the pixels covered by nucleus and cytoplasm.
Calculate the areas of each region assuming each pixel is 0.325 micrometers.
Calculate the ratio of nuclear to cytoplasmic volume using base area times height.
Estimate the normalized cytoplasmic mass based on fluorescence data and concentration ratios.
Estimate the normalized nuclear mass based on fluorescence data and concentration ratios.
Use the formula 1 + Rm = 1 + M_Nuc / M_Cyt to calculate the ratio of masses.
Assume the total protein mass (M_Nuc + M_Cyt) equals 100 for normalization purposes.
Calculate M_Cyt using the formula M_Cyt = 100 / (1 + Rm).
Calculate M_Nuc using the formula M_Nuc = (100 * Rm) / (1 + Rm).
Monitor knockdown efficiency of Taz/Yap by qPCR using cells plated in a 12-well dish.
Compare expression levels of Taz, Yap, Ankrd1, and Cyr61 in cells transfected with siCTL or siTaz/Yap.
Isolate total RNA from siCTL and siTaz/Yap transfected and serum starved cells using the PureLink RNA Mini Kit according to manufacturer's instructions.
Store purified RNA on ice.
Determine RNA concentration by NanoDrop One-C.
Generate cDNA using 1 μg of total RNA, oligo(dT) primers, and M-MLV reverse transcriptase following standard protocols including a DNaseI pre-digestion step.
Perform Real-time PCR using a 2X SYBR Green PCR master mix and validated primers.
For each well of a 384-well dish use 6.25 ng of cDNA template and 250 nM of each primer in a 10 μL reaction volume.

Perform PCR with the following cycle conditions: 95°C for 10 min, followed by 40 cycles at 95°C for 15 s, 60°C for 1 min; end with melting curve analysis at 95°C for 15 s, 60°C for 1 min and 95°C for 15 s.
Normalize gene expression to Hprt.
Calculate relative expression by the ΔΔCt method.
Place the 12-well dish of siTaz/Yap or siCTL transfected and serum starved cells on ice.
Wash cells three times with 1 mL of ice-cold PBS.
Add 150 μL of lysis buffer per well.
Rock the plate at 2°C–8°C for 15 min.
Scrape wells with a cell scraper.
Collect lysates into 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Centrifuge at 15,000 × g for 10 min.
Determine total protein concentration using the Bradford assay.
Adjust to achieve equal protein concentrations in all samples.
Add sample buffer and heat samples for 5 min at 95°C.
Load 15–25 μg of protein per lane.
Separate proteins by SDS-PAGE gel electrophoresis.
Transfer proteins to a nitrocellulose membrane using wet transfer.
Block membranes using 5% skim milk in TBS-T for 1 h.
Remove blocking solution from membranes.
Incubate membranes in primary antibodies diluted in TBS-T with 5% skim milk at 2°C–8°C overnight on a rocker.
Wash membranes with TBS-T buffer 3 times for 10 min each time on a rocker.
Incubate membranes with HRP-conjugated secondary antibodies diluted 1:5000 in blocking solution at RT (20°C–25°C) for 1 h on a rocker.
Wash membranes with TBS-T buffer 3 times for 10 min each time on a rocker.
Detect chemiluminescent signals using SuperSignalTM substrate as described by the manufacturer.
Image using an appropriate instrument such as the Versadoc (BioRad) or other Imager.
